lines.text: Solomon planned to build a house for the LORD's Name and conscripted 70,000 porters, 80,000 stonecutters, and 3,600 supervisors.
Solomon asked Hiram king of Tyre to send cedars, as he had for David, for a house of worship.
Solomon asked Hiram for a skilled craftsman and logs from Lebanon, and promised the woodcutters wheat, barley, wine, and oil.
Hiram sent Huram-abi, a skilled craftsman whose mother was from the daughters of Judah and whose father was from Tyre.
Hiram said his men would float logs by sea to Tarshish, and Solomon could take them to Jerusalem.
